name: Component watches lab test
description: Lab test of kiln.component_changes (named component watches, 07 S7) through Kiln.World's ComponentChanges, player-free on spawned 1_Player stand-ins: WATCH-NET-ORIGIN (a write without a token is Unknown, Combat.SetHealth is kiln.combat's, a tracked write is this mod's, a token with a write without one or two sources are Mixed, A to B to A gives nothing), WATCH-LINKS (an expanded watch covers the root's linked inventories; Items.Give is an Inventory change of a linked page, kiln.items' write, seen through the root's filter), WATCH-BUDGET (4096 present pairs exactly, one more refused, the 33rd watch refused, a destroyed root suspends its watch whole) and WATCH-COST (the window calls' p50 and p99 with 4096 pairs over 1600 steps), plain and with kiln/control/systems.parallel (WATCH-WORKER: tokens off the world thread, with kiln/control/impact.unpin); then the review's rows: WATCH-OVERLAP, WATCH-REUSE (root and linked), WATCH-SET-ROLLBACK (kiln/data/kiln.items/sets-lab), WATCH-QUEUE (kiln/control/watches.lab), WATCH-NOTE-COST (kiln/data/kiln.items/notes-lab), WATCH-GROWTH and WATCH-COST-ABSENT. kiln/data/component-watch-test/mode: keep, fresh or release run the stop and unload rows instead. PASS and FAIL lines in kiln.log, then 'component-watch-test done: N PASS, 0 FAIL'.
